young man seen from behind in centre foreground
river of white and red car lights

thick crowd of people as soft dark shapes on both pavements

wrong_setting: The dense, uniform high-rise towers read more like a generic East Asian megacity than the edge of Addis Ababa.
notes: Fill both pavements with a thick crowd of soft dark figures and add many more blue-and-white minibus taxis. Blank out the yellow roof sign on the left minibus. Swap the generic tower blocks for more Addis-like mid-rise concrete and glass buildings, and push the rendering toward soft gouache brushwork rather than inked comic lines.
